summary: Frontend-only re-test of /grid after 4 requested changes (alternated colors, unified meta textbox, size-variance slider, progressive resize mode). All four features work correctly. Regression tests (palettes, wrap, invert, flip, count slider, play/mic interlock, tokens stable on cut, mode-kinetic nav) all pass.

test_results_detail.alternated_colors: PASS - default blue palette shows mix of rgb(30,50,255) and rgb(255,255,255) cells (3 accent / 3 white). Same for red palette (255,30,30 + white) and bw (10,10,10 + white).
test_results_detail.unified_meta_textbox: PASS - grid-meta-input exists; grid-subtitle-input & grid-idx-input are GONE. Setting 'ALPHA;BETA;GAMMA DELTA;9999' renders 4 stacked <span> lines inside the meta cell, auto-fit (fitLines) with no overflow. Live update on change confirmed.
test_results_detail.sizevar_slider: PASS - grid-sizevar-slider present (1..10). Coefficient of variation of cell areas: cv_low(sizeVar=1)=0.390, cv_high(sizeVar=10)=1.012. Slider change re-randomizes layout immediately.
test_results_detail.progressive_resize_mode: PASS - grid-resize-all (default active) and grid-resize-progressive present. At count=12: ALL-mode Space cuts consistently changed 12/12 cells; PROG-mode cuts changed [6,12,7,4,12,12] cells - the pattern [2,3,all] is clearly visible with periodic full-refresh cuts and smaller cut steps in between. Note: at count=6 the BSP topology causes both modes to move all cells (2 mutated ratios high in the tree cascade to all descendants); this is inherent to BSP splits and expected — the feature is verifiable at count>=8.
test_results_detail.stable_on_cut: PASS - token text per cell index unchanged across 4 progressive Space cuts (only sizes change).
test_results_detail.palette_recolor_and_rearrange: PASS - red/bw/blue all produce a mix of accent/white bg cells; topoSeed increments cause re-arrangement.
test_results_detail.toggles: PASS - grid-wrap-toggle, grid-invert-toggle, grid-flip-toggle all clickable without crash; color transition has ease-in-out (background-color 0.4s ease-in-out, color 0.4s ease-in-out in GridStage).
test_results_detail.count_slider: PASS - setting count=9 rendered exactly 9 cell wrappers; count=12 rendered 12.
test_results_detail.play_mic_interlock: PASS - grid-play-button not disabled initially; after enabling mic (permission granted), play button becomes disabled=true. Mic toggle did not crash.
test_results_detail.navigation: PASS - mode-kinetic link and grid-font-select present.

critical_code_review_comments: Progressive mode at low count (e.g. count=6) is functionally correct (mutates only k ratios) but visually indistinguishable from 'all' mode because BSP root/near-root splits cascade to all descendants. Consider (optional) picking ratios biased toward leaf-level splits in mutateRatios, or scaling k relative to depth, to make the 'a couple / three / all' progression visible at small counts too.
assignContent uses Math.floor(n/2) for alternated color split — with odd n this yields 3/4 or 4/5 split, still balanced. Good.
Meta cell's fitLines uses lines.length*1.04 line-height factor but rendered span uses lineHeight 1.02 — minor mismatch, no visible issue.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 grid changes verified. If retesting progressive-mode behavior, use count>=8 to see the [2,3,all] cut pattern clearly (measured [6,12,7,4,12,12] cell-changes over 6 cuts at count=12).
